purpose: Common success criteria for future real-provider comparisons. These are a protocol, not results.

measurement.start: User submits first message, including navigation and reasoning
measurement.stop: Independent checker verifies required outcome and assistant emits final answer
measurement.failures: Keep failed, timed-out, and interrupted runs in denominator; do not rank speed only on easy survivors
measurement.providers: Record exact model IDs, CLI/API path, browser/app versions, hardware, region, network, cache state, logged-in state and budgets. Use same task data; identify unavoidable model differences.
measurement.unsupported: Record unsupported as unsupported, not passed; do not replace competitor services with mocks for live ranking.

messages: Find three stays in Lisbon for two people under €150 per night. Give me a numbered comparison.
Open the second one.
Does it have free cancellation?
Actually use Madrid with the same constraints.
checks: Second turn resolves second item from prior assistant response
Third turn answers from opened stay evidence
Fourth retains two people and €150 while changing only city
All four user and assistant messages remain visible after reopening task
tasks.requires: Live travel pages or a common deterministic local site accessible to every product; no reservation is submitted

messages: Summarize the current article in three sentences.
What does its second claim mean?
Find a primary source for that claim and open it in another tab.
Compare the two tabs.
checks: No navigation for the first two read-only turns
Reference resolves from prior answer
Source tab is created and has real supporting content
Comparison cites both observed sources
tasks.requires: A fixed archived or local article and source pair plus reachable search service

messages: Prepare preferences for Paris, Business cabin, traveler Ada. Add the traveler and review the preferences.
Change the traveler to Grace and keep everything else.
checks: First result is Paris / business / Ada
Second result is Paris / business / Grace
Exactly one add-traveler action
No duplicate review action within one requested turn
tasks.requires: tests/benchmarks/form.html, served on a host all compared browsers can reach

messages: Fill the preferences form but wait for my traveler name.
Stop
The traveler is Ada; continue from here.
checks: No input after stop acknowledgement
Current fields remain intact
Resume uses Ada without redoing completed controls
Task remains in same conversation
tasks.requires: Common local form and a controlled delayed response

messages: Compare the prices and cancellation policies in these three tabs.
Open the cheapest refundable option.
Ignore the unrelated tab I just opened.
checks: Only authorized source tabs contribute
Lowest qualifying price follows currency and cancellation constraints
Correct tab is activated
Unrelated new tab is excluded
tasks.requires: Fixed three comparison pages plus unrelated control page

messages: Complete the preferences form for Paris, Business cabin, traveler Ada.
checks: Replace observed node before first add-traveler input
Fresh observation occurs before input
Exactly one add and one review are recorded
Final fields match goal
tasks.requires: tests/benchmarks/form.html with the benchmark's controlled node replacement

messages: Set the destination in the embedded form, choose the custom calendar date, and review the draft.
checks: Same-origin iframe field is handled
Open shadow-root control is handled
Keyboard-only combobox is handled
No false complete if unsupported
tasks.requires: Shared iframe/shadow/keyboard widget fixture; support must be measured separately from simple DOM tasks

messages: Find three official sources about this technical change and explain where they agree or disagree.
Which source supports the second finding?
checks: Agent acquires new sources rather than summarizing only pre-open tabs
Each claim cites observed source evidence
Follow-up points to the actual second finding
Missing evidence is stated instead of invented
tasks.requires: Frozen topic/source corpus plus same search access or timestamped live web runs
